card.title: Link Discord
card.body: Link Discord and you'll get a message there when your match is called.
card.caveat: Discord is an extra alert. The crew still comes to get you.
card.stepCommand: Type /koble in Discord and pick it from the menu
card.expires: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {# more minute} other {# more minutes}}.
card.expired: That code expired. Get a new one.
card.waiting: Waiting for you to type /koble in Discord.
card.dmSent: I was able to send you a message on Discord.
card.dmUnconfirmed: Not confirmed yet. You still get the in-app alert.
card.dmBlockedBody: Turn on direct messages from server members in your Discord settings, then run /koble again.

probe.body: Your Discord account is linked to Summit. You'll get a message here when your match is called. Discord is an extra alert — the crew will come get you either way. You can unlink any time at turnering.mortenlab.xyz.

bot.linkedReply: Linked! You're **{name}** on Summit. I've sent you a message — check your DMs.
bot.linkedReplyBlocked: Linked! You're **{name}** on Summit. But I can't DM you. Turn on direct messages from server members in your Discord settings, then run `/koble` again.
bot.linkedReplyUnconfirmed: Linked! You're **{name}** on Summit. I couldn't confirm the DM got through, but you still get the in-app alert, and the crew comes for you.
bot.unknownCode: I couldn't find that code, or it expired. Get a new one at turnering.mortenlab.xyz → Profile → Link Discord.
bot.alreadyTaken: This Discord account is already linked to another Summit user. Tell the crew and they'll sort it out.
bot.noCode: Type `/koble` and paste the code from turnering.mortenlab.xyz → Profile → Link Discord.
bot.notLinked: This Discord account isn't linked to Summit.
bot.optedOut: OK, no more DMs. You still get the in-app alert, and the crew comes for you either way.
bot.optedIn: OK, you'll get DMs from Summit again.
